.arcade-hud{position:static;z-index:auto;grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(110px,1.4fr) repeat(3,minmax(74px,1fr));gap:5px;align-self:stretch;pointer-events:none}.arcade-metric{min-width:0;height:46px;background:#071426;border:1px solid #385270;border-radius:9px;padding:4px 7px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.arcade-metric.combo{border-color:#ffe176}.arcade-metric small{font-size:8px;line-height:1;color:#94a9c6;letter-spacing:.7px}.arcade-metric strong{font-size:14px;line-height:1.15;color:#eff7ff}.arcade-metric.combo strong{color:#ffe176}.arcade-metric.near strong{color:#58efff}.arcade-metric.max strong{color:#93ffb6}.arcade-metric.chain strong{color:#ff9cef}.arcade-metric i{display:block;width:100%;height:3px;margin-top:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#58efff calc(var(--combo)*100%),#24364d 0)}.arcade-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:74px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:center;text-align:left;background:#071426;border:1px solid #385270;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin:10px 0}.arcade-summary p{margin:4px 0}.arcade-grade{font:900 48px/1 system-ui;text-align:center;color:#fff}.grade-S{color:#ffe176;text-shadow:0 0 12px #ffe176}.grade-A{color:#58efff}.grade-B,.grade-C{color:#93ffb6}.grade-D{color:#ff8b8b}.arcade-multi-summary{display:grid;gap:8px}@media(max-width:600px){.arcade-hud{height:34px;min-height:34px;grid-template-columns:1.35fr repeat(3,1fr);gap:3px}.arcade-metric{height:34px;padding:2px 3px;border-radius:7px}.arcade-metric small{font-size:6.5px;letter-spacing:0}.arcade-metric strong{font-size:10px}.arcade-metric i{height:2px;margin-top:1px}.hud{gap:3px}.stage,#stage{min-height:0}}@media(max-width:360px){.arcade-metric small{display:none}.arcade-metric strong{font-size:9px}}

(()=>{'use strict';
const COMBO_WINDOW=1.25,MAX_MULTIPLIER=8,NEAR_DISTANCE=.86,NEAR_COOLDOWN=2;
function stats(){return{pellets:0,powers:0,ghosts:0,shots:0,nearMisses:0,comboCount:0,maxCombo:0,multiplier:1,comboTimer:0,ghostChain:0,comboBonus:0,ghostPoints:0,nearPoints:0,livesStart:0,levelStartScore:0}}
function ensure(g=game){if(!g)return null;if(!g.arcade)g.arcade=stats();return g.arcade}
function resetArcade(){if(!game)return;game.arcade=stats();game.arcade.livesStart=game.lives;game.arcade.levelStartScore=game.score;game.arcadeNear={};if(game.players)for(const p of game.players){p.arcade=stats();p.arcade.livesStart=game.lives}}
function collect(a,base,popupTarget){a.comboCount++;a.comboTimer=COMBO_WINDOW;a.multiplier=Math.min(MAX_MULTIPLIER,1+Math.floor(a.comboCount/10));a.maxCombo=Math.max(a.maxCombo,a.multiplier);const extra=base*(a.multiplier-1);a.comboBonus+=extra;if(extra>0){addScoreRaw(extra);if(popupTarget)popup('x'+a.multiplier,popupTarget.x,popupTarget.y,'#ffe176')}return extra}
function decay(a,dt){if(!a||a.comboTimer<=0)return;a.comboTimer=Math.max(0,a.comboTimer-dt);if(a.comboTimer===0){a.comboCount=0;a.multiplier=1}}
function grade(score,maxCombo,near,lost,cleared=true){if(!cleared)return score>=15000?'C':score>=7000?'D':'D';let merit=0;if(score>=25000)merit+=3;else if(score>=15000)merit+=2;else if(score>=8000)merit++;if(maxCombo>=8)merit+=2;else if(maxCombo>=4)merit++;if(near>=3)merit++;if(lost===0)merit++;return ['D','C','B','A','S'][Math.min(4,merit)]}
function panel(a,cleared=true,score=game?.score||0,lost=Math.max(0,(a?.livesStart||0)-(game?.lives||0))){if(!a)return'';return `<section class="arcade-summary" aria-label="Riepilogo punteggio arcade"><div class="arcade-grade grade-${grade(score,a.maxCombo,a.nearMisses,lost,cleared)}">${grade(score,a.maxCombo,a.nearMisses,lost,cleared)}</div><div><strong>ARCADE BREAKDOWN</strong><p>Palline ${a.pellets} Â· Power ${a.powers} Â· Fantasmi ${a.ghosts}</p><p>Bonus combo ${a.comboBonus.toLocaleString('it-IT')} Â· Ghost chain ${a.ghostPoints.toLocaleString('it-IT')} Â· Near miss ${a.nearPoints.toLocaleString('it-IT')}</p><p>Combo massima x${a.maxCombo} Â· Vite perse ${lost}</p></div></section>`}
const addScoreRaw=addScore;
const loadLevelRaw=loadLevel;window.loadLevel=function(...x){const v=loadLevelRaw.apply(this,x);resetArcade();return v};
const startGameRaw=startGame;window.startGame=function(...x){const v=startGameRaw.apply(this,x);resetArcade();return v};
const consumeRaw=consume;window.consume=function(p){const v=game?.map?.[p.y]?.[p.x],before=game?.score||0,out=consumeRaw(p),a=ensure();if(v===0||v===3){v===3?a.powers++:a.pellets++;collect(a,v===3?50:10,p);if(v===3)a.ghostChain=0}return out};
const eatGhostRaw=eatGhost;window.eatGhost=function(g,shot=false){const eligible=g.state!=='eyes'&&g.wait<=0,a=ensure(),before=game.score,out=eatGhostRaw(g,shot);if(eligible){a.ghosts++;a.shots+=shot?1:0;if(!shot&&game.power>0){const chain=Math.min(4,++a.ghostChain),target=200*2**(chain-1),base=game.score-before,diff=Math.max(0,target-base);if(diff){addScoreRaw(diff);a.ghostPoints+=diff}popup('CHAIN x'+chain,g.x,g.y,'#58efff')}else a.ghostChain=0}return out};
const dieRaw=die;window.die=function(...x){const before=game?.lives,out=dieRaw.apply(this,x);if(game&&game.lives<before){const a=ensure();a.comboCount=0;a.multiplier=1;a.comboTimer=0;a.ghostChain=0}return out};
function scanNear(dt){if(state!=='playing'||!game?.player||!game.ghosts||game.invuln>0)return;game.arcadeNear??={};for(let i=0;i<game.ghosts.length;i++){const g=game.ghosts[i],n=game.arcadeNear[i]??={cooldown:0,armed:false,entryX:0,entryY:0};n.cooldown=Math.max(0,n.cooldown-dt);if(g.state==='eyes'||g.wait>0||game.power>0)continue;const d=Math.hypot(g.x-game.player.x,g.y-game.player.y);if(d>=.65&&d<NEAR_DISTANCE&&!n.cooldown&&!n.armed){n.armed=true;n.entryX=game.player.x;n.entryY=game.player.y}if(n.armed&&d>=1.05&&Math.hypot(game.player.x-n.entryX,game.player.y-n.entryY)>=1.2){const a=ensure(),points=100*a.multiplier;addScoreRaw(points);a.nearMisses++;a.nearPoints+=points;n.cooldown=NEAR_COOLDOWN;n.armed=false;popup('CLOSE! +'+points,game.player.x,game.player.y,'#ff9cef');tone(1050,.06,'triangle',.02)}if(d>2.5)n.armed=false}}
const updateRaw=update;window.update=function(dt){const out=updateRaw(dt);if(!net?.active){const a=ensure();decay(a,dt);scanNear(dt)}else if(game?.players)for(const p of game.players)decay(p.arcade,dt);return out};
const consumeNetRaw=networkConsume;window.networkConsume=function(p,id){const v=game?.map?.[p.y]?.[p.x],before=p.points,out=consumeNetRaw(p,id);if(v===0||v===3){p.arcade??=stats();v===3?p.arcade.powers++:p.arcade.pellets++;p.arcade.comboCount++;p.arcade.comboTimer=COMBO_WINDOW;p.arcade.multiplier=Math.min(MAX_MULTIPLIER,1+Math.floor(p.arcade.comboCount/10));p.arcade.maxCombo=Math.max(p.arcade.maxCombo,p.arcade.multiplier);const base=v===3?50:10,extra=base*(p.arcade.multiplier-1);p.points+=extra;p.arcade.comboBonus+=extra;if(v===3)p.arcade.ghostChain=0}return out};
const startNetRaw=startNetworkRound;window.startNetworkRound=function(...x){const out=startNetRaw.apply(this,x);if(game?.players)for(const p of game.players){p.arcade=stats();p.arcade.livesStart=game.lives}return out};
function decorateResult(cleared){const target=document.querySelector('#modal .record');if(target&&!document.querySelector('.arcade-summary'))target.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend',panel(ensure(),cleared))}
const clearRaw=clearLevel;window.clearLevel=function(...x){const out=clearRaw.apply(this,x);decorateResult(true);return out};
const overRaw=gameOver;window.gameOver=function(...x){const out=overRaw.apply(this,x);decorateResult(false);return out};
const resultRaw=networkResultPanel;window.networkResultPanel=function(...x){const out=resultRaw.apply(this,x);const rec=document.querySelector('#modal .record');if(rec&&game?.players&&!document.querySelector('.arcade-multi-summary')){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='arcade-multi-summary';d.innerHTML=game.players.map((p,i)=>panel(p.arcade,!!game.cleared,p.points,Math.max(0,(p.arcade?.livesStart||game.lives)-game.lives)).replace('ARCADE BREAKDOWN',(i?'BRUNO':'GIOVANNI')+' Â· ARCADE')).join('');rec.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',d)}return out};
function arcadeHud(){let h=$('arcadeHud');if(!h){h=document.createElement('div');h.id='arcadeHud';h.className='arcade-hud';h.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');document.querySelector('.hud')?.appendChild(h)}const a=net?.active&&game?.players?game.players[net.host?0:1].arcade:game?.arcade;if(!a){h.hidden=true;return}h.hidden=false;h.innerHTML=`<div class="arcade-metric combo" data-max="x${a.maxCombo}" data-near="${a.nearMisses}" data-chain="x${a.ghostChain}"><small>COMBO</small><strong>x${a.multiplier} Â· ${a.comboCount%10}/10</strong><i style="--combo:${Math.max(0,Math.min(1,a.comboTimer/COMBO_WINDOW))}"></i></div><div class="arcade-metric near"><small>NEAR MISS</small><strong>${a.nearMisses}</strong></div><div class="arcade-metric max"><small>MAX COMBO</small><strong>x${a.maxCombo}</strong></div><div class="arcade-metric chain"><small>GHOST CHAIN</small><strong>x${a.ghostChain}</strong></div>`}
const hudRaw=hud;window.hud=function(...x){const out=hudRaw.apply(this,x);arcadeHud();return out};
window.PacPacArcade240={stats,grade,panel,resetArcade};
})();

# Changelog
## 4.7.9 - correzione simboli e codifica UTF-8
- Ripristinati accenti, apostrofi tipografici, frecce, icone, emoji e simboli dei controlli.
- Corretti i nomi SighiÈ™oara e BraÈ™ov.
- Uniformata la codifica testuale dei moduli a UTF-8.
- Visualizer e gameplay 4.7.8 invariati.
## 4.7.8 - audio visualizer futuristico
- Aggiunto visualizer audio futuristico sullo sfondo.
- Le barre reagiscono alla musica tramite Web Audio Analyser.
- In assenza di segnale audio resta attiva una delicata animazione ambientale.
- Il visualizer non intercetta input e rispetta `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Gameplay e funzionalita della 4.7.7 restano invariati.
## 4.7.7 - completabilita labirinti, rientro fantasmi e audio morte
- Aggiunta riparazione runtime della raggiungibilita per tutti gli otto labirinti della Storia.
- Corretto il labirinto 2 e impedita la generazione di aree obbligatorie isolate.
- Il respawn dei fantasmi avviene nella base del castello, mai sulla posizione del giocatore.
- Aggiunto recupero anti-blocco nel ritorno alla base anche in Arcade.
- Alla morte viene riprodotto `audio/gameover.mp3`, con fallback sonoro non bloccante.
- Tutto il resto della 4.7.6 resta invariato.

## 4.7.6 - super poteri nella caccia al boss
- Ridotta la velocitÃ  del boss a valori raggiungibili, mantenendo lâ€™IA evasiva.

## 4.7.5 - insegna G&B, boss evasivo e audio ducking

## 4.7.4 - caccia al boss nella Storia
- Rimossi palline, Power Sphere, Power Birra e Power Stella dallâ€™area visiva del castello.

# PAC PAC feature contract 4.5.0
Historical baseline: 2.5.1 and releases 2.8.0 through 3.3.2.
Required 4.0 features: JSON campaign, manifest, procedural Arcade, Level Studio, QR, dynamic doors, paired portals, campaign progression, daily challenge and local-only metrics.
Gate: every `tests/*.test.js` suite must pass.

Required 4.1 features: in-game manual, standalone manual page, local responsive splash assets and reduced-motion support.

Required 4.2 features: eight story chapters, Giovanni and Bruno narrative, companion rendering, Bond meter, story persistence, finale and responsive story splash.

Required 4.3 features: character backgrounds, five Transylvania chapters, Trastevere, Colosseum, Vatican finale, journey splash and story persistence v430.

Required 4.4: Ralph narrator, comic bubbles, three original castle antagonists, Dracula boss, chaotic Rome portals, Trastevere, Colosseum and fictional Vatican guardian boss.

Required 4.5: eight distinct mazes, water blocking, rivers, torches, traps, moving walls, no castle collectibles, Beer/Star powers, 120% speed, infinite rapid fire and concise kidnapping narrative.

Required 4.7.0: preserve the exact 4.5.0 splash behavior; all eight Story acts start; modern menu; clean UTF-8; visible castle and boss per act; live boss dialogue; reachable ghost home; stuck recovery; solid moving walls; recognizable braziers; all 4.5.0 features retained.

Required 4.7.1: organized three-section main menu; PNG-only result sharing containing level, score, ranking, combo, near miss and ghost chain; no wa.me text result; download fallback; all gameplay unchanged.

Required 4.7.2: compact no-scroll launcher; existing menu actions preserved; signed PNG result card; selected Giovanni, Bruno or PAC PAC icon; exactly 30 preset challenge phrases; no editable WhatsApp result text; gameplay unchanged.

Required 4.7.3: animated dynamic launcher; reduced-motion support; Giovanni, Bruno and PAC PAC selection audio; normal and Story completion audio; non-blocking Web Audio beep fallback when MP3 is absent or rejected; 4.7.2 gameplay unchanged.

Required 4.7.4: no collectibles under the Story castle; the last collectible starts boss chase instead of completion; boss capture completes the act; `grido-battaglia.mp3` at chase start; `missione-compiuta.mp3` at actual completion; non-Story modes unchanged; clean special characters.

Required 4.7.5: only current version in main menu; large `PAC PAC G&B` sign; smarter Story boss with BFS distance, escape-space and dead-end avoidance; adaptive sprint; background music reduced by exactly 40% only while `grido-battaglia.mp3` plays, then restored; all other behavior unchanged.

Required 4.7.6: Story boss remains intelligent but catchable; chase-only 42% player speed boost; FIRE activates 0.62s Bond Dash and 2.6s boss slow with 1.65s cooldown; no ammunition cost; ghost protection and visible cooldown during chase; all non-chase behavior unchanged.

Required 4.7.7: every Story maze is fully reachable at runtime; eyes return to the castle ghost base with anti-stuck recovery in Arcade and Story; death requests `audio/gameover.mp3` with non-blocking fallback; all other 4.7.6 behavior unchanged.

Required 4.7.8: futuristic non-interactive background audio visualizer, Web Audio reactive when available, ambient fallback, reduced-motion support; all gameplay unchanged.

<script src="./multiplayer-config.js"></script><script>
'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),canvas=$('game'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const N=23,T=30,DIRS=[[0,-1],[1,0],[0,1],[-1,0]],HOME={x:11,y:11},SPAWN={x:11,y:21};
const DEFAULT={graphics:'balanced',difficulty:'normal',touch:'off',layout:'standard',music:true,musicVolume:100,musicSource:'project',character:'giovanni',speechBubble:true,powerIcon:'classic',projectileIcon:'classic',pelletIcon:'classic',vibration:false,ghostSkill:'normal',ghostStyle:'classic',ghostSpeed:'slower',touchSize:'normal',highContrast:false,fireMode:'hold',swipeSensitivity:'normal',sound:true,effects:true};
function readStore(k,f){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k))??f}catch{return f}}
function saveStore(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v))}catch{}}
let settings={...DEFAULT,...readStore('neonArcadeSettings',{})};
if(!['performance','balanced','quality'].includes(settings.graphics))settings.graphics='balanced';
if(!['easy','normal','hard'].includes(settings.difficulty))settings.difficulty='normal';
if(!['off','pad','swipe','both'].includes(settings.touch))settings.touch='off';
if(!['standard','landscape'].includes(settings.layout))settings.layout='standard';
for(const [id,values]of Object.entries({ghostSkill:['basic','normal','expert'],ghostStyle:['classic','chase','ambush','team','patrol'],ghostSpeed:['slower','equal','faster']}))if(!values.includes(settings[id]))settings[id]=DEFAULT[id];
if(typeof settings.vibration!=='boolean')settings.vibration=false;
for(const id of ['pelletIcon','powerIcon','projectileIcon'])if(!['classic','beer','cherry','star','rainbow','rocket','fire','diamond','lightning','heart'].includes(settings[id]))settings[id]='classic';
if(!['pac','giovanni','bruno'].includes(settings.character))settings.character='giovanni';if(typeof settings.speechBubble!=='boolean')settings.speechBubble=true;
if(typeof settings.music!=='boolean')settings.music=true;settings.musicVolume=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Number(settings.musicVolume)||0));if(!['project','original','file'].includes(settings.musicSource))settings.musicSource='project';
if(readStore('pacPacAudioDefaults',0)!==170){settings.musicSource='project';settings.musicVolume=100;saveStore('pacPacAudioDefaults',170)}
let activeGhosts={skill:settings.ghostSkill,style:settings.ghostStyle,speed:settings.ghostSpeed};
let records=readStore('neonArcadeRecords',{});if(!records||typeof records!=='object')records={};
const CONFIG={easy:{ghost:4.05,power:9,lives:5},normal:{ghost:4.65,power:7,lives:3},hard:{ghost:5.1,power:5,lives:3}};
let state='menu',game=null,activeDifficulty=settings.difficulty,frameTime=0,accumulator=0,clock=0,shake=0,fireHeld=false,firePointer=null,particles=[],floats=[],audio=null,toastUntil=0;
const images={pac:null,power:null,weapon:null};
let tutorial=null;
function seeded(seed){let a=seed>>>0;return()=>{a+=0x6D2B79F5;let t=a;t=Math.imul(t^(t>>>15),t|1);t^=t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),t|61);return((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296}}
const key=(x,y)=>y*N+x;
function walk(map,x,y){return x>=0&&y>=0&&x<N&&y<N&&!([1,7,10].includes(map[y][x]))}
function neighbors(map,x,y){return DIRS.map(([dx,dy],d)=>({x:x+dx,y:y+dy,d})).filter(p=>walk(map,p.x,p.y))}
function distancesRaw(map,target){const out=new Int16Array(N*N).fill(-1);if(!walk(map,target.x,target.y))return out;const q=[target];out[key(target.x,target.y)]=0;for(let i=0;i<q.length;i++){const p=q[i];for(const n of neighbors(map,p.x,p.y)){const k=key(n.x,n.y);if(out[k]<0){out[k]=out[key(p.x,p.y)]+1;q.push(n)}}}return out}
function validateMapRaw(map){const ds=distancesRaw(map,SPAWN);let floor=0,reachable=0,deadEnds=0;for(let y=0;y<N;y++)for(let x=0;x<N;x++)if(walk(map,x,y)){floor++;if(ds[key(x,y)]>=0)reachable++;if(neighbors(map,x,y).length<2)deadEnds++}return{valid:floor===reachable&&ds[key(HOME.x,HOME.y)]>=0&&deadEnds===0,floor,reachable,deadEnds}}
function generateLevelRaw(level){
 // Deterministic spanning maze, then braided loops: every cell is connected by construction.
 const rand=seeded(0xA11CE+level*7919),map=Array.from({length:N},()=>Array(N).fill(1)),stack=[{x:1,y:1}];map[1][1]=0;

$('fullBtn').onclick=async()=>{try{if(document.fullscreenElement)await document.exitFullscreen();else if(document.documentElement.requestFullscreen)await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();else toast('Schermo intero non disponibile in questo browser.')}catch{toast('Schermo intero non disponibile.')}requestAnimationFrame(fit)};
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.target.matches('input,select,textarea')||((e.key===' '||e.key==='Enter')&&e.target.closest('button')))return;const k=e.key.toLowerCase();if(k==='tab'&&!$('modal').classList.contains('hidden')){const els=[...$('panel').querySelectorAll('button,select,input,summary')].filter(el=>el.getClientRects().length);const first=els[0],last=els.at(-1);if(e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){e.preventDefault();last?.focus()}else if(!e.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){e.preventDefault();first?.focus()}return}if(k==='p'||k==='escape'){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat){if(state==='tutorial')$('pauseBtn').click();else pause()}return}if(!['playing','tutorial'].includes(state))return;const d={arrowup:0,w:0,arrowright:1,d:1,arrowdown:2,s:2,arrowleft:3,a:3}[k];if(d!==undefined){e.preventDefault();requestDir(d)}if(k===' '){e.preventDefault();if(state==='tutorial'){toast('Nel tutorial usa il pulsante FIRE sullo schermo.');return}if(!e.repeat)shoot()}});

let padPointer=null,padDirection=null;
function announceControl(text){$('controlAnnouncement').textContent=text}
function activateDirection(d){if(settings.touch==='off'||settings.touch==='swipe'||!['playing','tutorial'].includes(state))return;requestDir(d);tutorialDirection('pad',d);announceControl(['Su','Destra','GiÃ¹','Sinistra'][d]);document.querySelectorAll('[data-dir]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('pressed',Number(b.dataset.dir)===d))}
for(const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-dir]')){
 b.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(settings.touch==='off'||settings.touch==='swipe')return;e.preventDefault();if(padPointer!==null)return;b.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);padPointer=e.pointerId;padDirection=Number(b.dataset.dir);activateDirection(padDirection)});
 b.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.detail===0)activateDirection(Number(b.dataset.dir))});
 for(const ev of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])b.addEventListener(ev,e=>{if(e.pointerId!==padPointer)return;document.querySelectorAll('[data-dir]').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('pressed'));padPointer=null;padDirection=null});
}
$('pad').addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(e.pointerId!==padPointer)return;e.preventDefault();const hit=document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX,e.clientY)?.closest('[data-dir]');if(!hit||!$('pad').contains(hit))return;const d=Number(hit.dataset.dir);if(d===padDirection)return;padDirection=d;activateDirection(d)});
function stopTouchFire(){fireHeld=false;firePointer=null;if(settings.fireMode==='toggle')$('fire').setAttribute('aria-pressed','false')}
function activateFire(){
 if(settings.touch==='off'||!['playing','tutorial'].includes(state))return;
 if(state==='tutorial'&&tutorial){tutorial.suspended=false;if(tutorial.phases[tutorial.index]!=='fire'){toast('Completa prima le quattro direzioni.');return}}
 if(settings.fireMode==='toggle'){fireHeld=!fireHeld;$('fire').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(fireHeld));announceControl(fireHeld?'Sparo automatico attivo':'Sparo automatico fermato');if(fireHeld)shoot()}
 else{fireHeld=settings.fireMode==='hold';shoot();announceControl(game.ammo>0?'Spara':'Munizioni esaurite')}
}
$('fire').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(settings.touch==='off')return;e.preventDefault();if(firePointer!==null)return;firePointer=e.pointerId;$('fire').setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);activateFire()});
for(const ev of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])$('fire').addEventListener(ev,e=>{if(e.pointerId!==firePointer)return;firePointer=null;if(settings.fireMode!=='toggle'||ev==='pointercancel'){stopTouchFire()}});
$('fire').addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.detail===0){activateFire();if(settings.fireMode==='hold')fireHeld=false}});
for(const id of ['pad','fire'])$(id).addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>e.preventDefault());
let swipe=null;canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(!['swipe','both'].includes(settings.touch)||!['playing','tutorial'].includes(state))return;e.preventDefault();canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);swipe={id:e.pointerId,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY}});canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!swipe||swipe.id!==e.pointerId)return;e.preventDefault();const dx=e.clientX-swipe.x,dy=e.clientY-swipe.y;const threshold=settings.swipeSensitivity==='gentle'?7:Math.max(10,Math.min(24,canvas.getBoundingClientRect().width/N*.7));if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<threshold)return;const d=Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?(dx>0?1:3):(dy>0?2:0);requestDir(d);tutorialDirection('swipe',d);swipe.x=e.clientX;swipe.y=e.clientY});for(const ev of['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])canvas.addEventListener(ev,e=>{if(swipe?.id===e.pointerId)swipe=null});
function autoPause(){stopPelletAudio();stopMusic();stopTouchFire();if(state==='tutorial'&&tutorial){tutorial.suspended=true;tutorial.pending=null;game.player.moving=false;game.player.x=Math.round(game.player.x);game.player.y=Math.round(game.player.y);$('tutorialText').textContent='Tutorial sospeso. Tocca un comando per continuare.'}fireHeld=false;firePointer=null;swipe=null;if(state==='playing'||state==='ready')pause()}
window.addEventListener('blur',autoPause);document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)autoPause()});window.addEventListener('resize',fit);if(window.ResizeObserver){const observer=new ResizeObserver(()=>requestAnimationFrame(fit));observer.observe($('boardArea'));observer.observe($('stage'))}if(window.visualViewport)window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize',fit);

function tutorialIntro(previous){
 const savedGame=game;state='tutorialIntro';
 showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">PALESTRA TOUCH</div><h2 id="dialogTitle">Impara i controlli</h2><p>Prova i movimenti e lo sparo in un'arena senza fantasmi. Nessuna vita persa e nessun effetto sul record. La partita in corso resta conservata.</p><div class="row"><label for="tutorialMode">Abilita controlli touch</label><select id="tutorialMode"><option value="pad">D-Pad + FIRE</option><option value="swipe">Swipe + FIRE</option><option value="both">D-Pad + swipe + FIRE</option></select></div><p class="note">Questa scelta abilita e salva i controlli smartphone nelle impostazioni. Puoi cambiarla successivamente.</p><div class="actions"><button class="primary" id="beginTutorial">Inizia esercitazione</button><button id="cancelTutorial">Indietro</button></div>`);
 $('tutorialMode').value=settings.touch==='off'?'both':settings.touch;
 $('cancelTutorial').onclick=()=>{if(previous==='menu')mainMenu();else{state=previous;hideModal()}};
 $('beginTutorial').onclick=()=>{settings.touch=$('tutorialMode').value;applySettings();startTutorial(previous,savedGame)};
}
function startTutorial(previous,savedGame){firePointer=null;fireHeld=false;swipe=null;
 const phases=[];if(['pad','both'].includes(settings.touch))phases.push('pad');if(['swipe','both'].includes(settings.touch))phases.push('swipe');phases.push('fire');
 tutorial={previous,savedGame,phases,index:0,done:new Set(),shots:0,pending:null,suspended:false};
 game={level:1,score:0,lives:0,ammo:99,extraAt:Infinity,map:Array.from({length:N},(_,y)=>Array.from({length:N},(_,x)=>x===0||y===0||x===N-1||y===N-1?1:2)),player:entity(11,11),ghosts:[],bullets:[],power:0,invuln:0,cooldown:0,remaining:0,mode:'scatter'};
 state='tutorial';document.body.classList.add('training');$('tutorialBar').classList.remove('hidden');hideModal();renderTutorial();requestAnimationFrame(fit);
}
function renderTutorial(){
 if(!tutorial)return;const phase=tutorial.phases[tutorial.index];
 document.querySelectorAll('.tutorial-target').forEach(e=>e.classList.remove('tutorial-target'));
 $('tutorialTitle').textContent=`Tutorial ${tutorial.index+1}/${tutorial.phases.length} Â· ${phase==='pad'?'D-Pad':phase==='swipe'?'Swipe':'FIRE'}`;
 $('tutorialText').textContent=tutorial.suspended?'In pausa. Tocca un comando o Pausa per riprendere.':phase==='pad'?'Tocca le quattro frecce: il personaggio continua a muoversi. Puoi preparare la prossima svolta.':phase==='swipe'?'Scorri sul labirinto nelle quattro direzioni. Non serve trascinare il personaggio.':(settings.fireMode==='toggle'?'Tocca FIRE per attivare lo sparo. Un altro tocco lo ferma.':settings.fireMode==='single'?'Tocca FIRE tre volte: un colpo per ogni tocco.':'Tocca FIRE tre volte, oppure tienilo premuto per lo sparo continuo.');
 $('tutorialProgress').textContent=phase==='fire'?`Colpi sparati: ${tutorial.shots}/3`:'Direzioni: '+['â†‘','â†’','â†“','â†'].map((v,d)=>v+(tutorial.done.has(d)?' âœ“':' â—‹')).join('  ');
 if(phase==='pad')document.querySelectorAll('[data-dir]').forEach(b=>{if(!tutorial.done.has(Number(b.dataset.dir)))b.classList.add('tutorial-target')});
 if(phase==='swipe')canvas.classList.add('tutorial-target');if(phase==='fire')$('fire').classList.add('tutorial-target');
}
function tutorialDirection(source,d){
 if(state!=='tutorial'||!tutorial)return;tutorial.suspended=false;
 if(tutorial.phases[tutorial.index]!==source){renderTutorial();return}
 if(!tutorial.done.has(d))tutorial.pending={d,x:game.player.x,y:game.player.y};renderTutorial();
}
function tutorialShot(){
 if(!tutorial||state!=='tutorial')return;tutorial.suspended=false;
 if(tutorial.phases[tutorial.index]!=='fire')return;
 tutorial.shots++;renderTutorial();if(tutorial.shots>=3)finishTutorial();
}
function nextTutorialPhase(){tutorial.index++;tutorial.done.clear();tutorial.pending=null;game.player=entity(11,11);game.bullets=[];tone(900,.12);renderTutorial()}
function updateTutorial(dt){
 if(!tutorial||tutorial.suspended)return;game.cooldown=Math.max(0,game.cooldown-dt);
 move(game.player,PLAYER_SPEED*dt,playerChoice);
 const p=tutorial.pending;if(p){const [dx,dy]=DIRS[p.d];if((game.player.x-p.x)*dx+(game.player.y-p.y)*dy>=.3){tutorial.done.add(p.d);tutorial.pending=null;renderTutorial();if(tutorial.done.size===4)nextTutorialPhase()}}
 if(fireHeld)shoot();if(state!=='tutorial')return;
 for(const b of game.bullets){b.life-=dt;b.x+=b.dx*13*dt;b.y+=b.dy*13*dt;if(!walk(game.map,Math.round(b.x),Math.round(b.y)))b.life=0}game.bullets=game.bullets.filter(b=>b.life>0);
 $('status').textContent='ESERCITAZIONE Â· Nessun nemico Â· Nessun punteggio';
}
function finishTutorial(){
 state='tutorialDone';fireHeld=false;tutorial.pending=null;
 showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">ESERCITAZIONE COMPLETATA</div><h2 id="dialogTitle">Controlli pronti!</h2><p>Hai provato ${tutorial.phases.includes('pad')?'il D-Pad, ':''}${tutorial.phases.includes('swipe')?'gli swipe, ':''}e il pulsante FIRE. In partita puoi muoverti e sparare contemporaneamente.</p><div class="actions"><button class="primary" id="tutorialReturn">${tutorial.previous==='menu'?'Torna al menu':'Riprendi la partita'}</button><button id="tutorialRepeat">Ripeti tutorial</button></div>`);
 $('tutorialReturn').onclick=exitTutorial;$('tutorialRepeat').onclick=()=>{const {previous,savedGame}=tutorial;startTutorial(previous,savedGame)};
}
function exitTutorial(){
 if(!tutorial)return;const {previous,savedGame}=tutorial;tutorial=null;game=savedGame;fireHeld=false;firePointer=null;swipe=null;
 document.body.classList.remove('training');$('tutorialBar').classList.add('hidden');document.querySelectorAll('.tutorial-target').forEach(e=>e.classList.remove('tutorial-target'));
 if(previous==='menu')mainMenu();else{state=previous;hideModal()}requestAnimationFrame(fit);
}
$('tutorialExit').onclick=exitTutorial;


function adaptControls(){
 const stage=$('stage').getBoundingClientRect(),controls=$('controls');
 const landscape=settings.layout==='landscape'&&window.innerWidth>window.innerHeight;
 const training=!!tutorial;
 let kh,kw,fire;
 if(landscape){
  const banner=training?$('tutorialBar').getBoundingClientRect().height+8:0;
  const available=Math.max(120,stage.height-banner-16);
  const cw=controls.getBoundingClientRect().width||Math.min(280,window.innerWidth*.27);
  kh=window.innerHeight<=480?44:Math.max(44,Math.min(60,Math.floor((available-32)/4.5)));
  kw=Math.max(44,Math.min(72,Math.floor((cw-24)/3)));
  fire=Math.max(40,Math.min(88,Math.floor(available-(kh*3+8)-24)));
 }else{
  const compact=window.innerHeight<620;
  kh=window.innerWidth>=700?56:44;
  kw=Math.max(44,Math.min(window.innerWidth>=700?68:56,Math.floor((window.innerWidth-110)/3)));
  fire=compact?60:window.innerWidth>=700?92:80;
 }
 if(settings.touchSize==='large'){kh=Math.max(kh,56);kw=Math.max(kw,56);fire=Math.max(fire,80)}
 for(const [name,value]of [['--key-h',kh],['--key-w',kw],['--fire-size',fire]]){const v=value+'px';if(controls.style.getPropertyValue(name)!==v)controls.style.setProperty(name,v)}
}
function updateLayoutPreview(){
 const box=$('layoutPreview');if(!box)return;
 const layout=$('layout').value,touch=$('touch').value,size=$('previewSize').value;
 box.className='preview-device'+(layout==='standard'?' standard':'')+(touch==='off'?' touch-off':'')+(touch==='swipe'?' swipe-only':'');
 box.style.aspectRatio=layout==='landscape'?(size==='tablet'?'4 / 3':size==='compact'?'16 / 9':'20 / 9'):(size==='tablet'?'3 / 4':'9 / 16');
 box.style.maxWidth=layout==='landscape'?'410px':'190px';
 $('previewNote').textContent=(layout==='landscape'?'Orizzontale: gioco a sinistra, controlli a destra. Ruota il dispositivo per attivare questa disposizione.':'Standard: controlli sotto il gioco, anche ruotando il dispositivo.')+(touch==='off'?' Controlli touch disattivati: abilitali nel menu sopra.':'')+' Anteprima indicativa; le dimensioni si adattano allo spazio disponibile.';
 const cv=$('previewBoard'),c=cv.getContext('2d'),map=generateLevel(1),t=10;
 c.fillStyle='#050915';c.fillRect(0,0,230,230);
 for(let y=0;y<N;y++)for(let x=0;x<N;x++){const v=map[y][x];if(v===1){c.fillStyle='#17415b';c.fillRect(x*t+1,y*t+1,8,8)}else if(v===0){drawPellet(c,x*t+5,y*t+5,t,$('pelletIcon')?.value||settings.pelletIcon)}else if(v===3){const theme=$('powerIcon')?.value||settings.powerIcon;if(theme!=='classic')drawPellet(c,x*t+5,y*t+5,t*1.35,theme);c.strokeStyle='#ff68bc';c.fillStyle='#ff68bc';c.beginPath();c.arc(x*t+5,y*t+5,theme==='classic'?2.5:4.5,0,Math.PI*2);if(theme==='classic')c.fill();else c.stroke()}}
 paintCharacter(c,115,215,9,$('character')?.value||settings.character);c.fillStyle='#ff647c';c.fillRect(111,111,8,8);
}


const PELLET_ICONS={classic:'â—',beer:'Birra',cherry:'Ciliegie',star:'â˜…',rainbow:'Arcobaleno',rocket:'Razzo',fire:'Fuoco',diamond:'Diamante',lightning:'Fulmine',heart:'Cuore'};
const pelletSprites=new Map();
function drawPellet(c,x,y,t,theme){
 if(theme==='classic'||!PELLET_ICONS[theme]){c.fillStyle='#ffe6a3';c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,t*.077,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();return}
 const size=Math.max(7,Math.round(t*.62)),id=theme+':'+size;
 if(!pelletSprites.has(id)){
  const sprite=document.createElement('canvas');sprite.width=sprite.height=size*3;
  const sc=sprite.getContext('2d');sc.scale(3,3);sc.font=size+'px "Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Noto Color Emoji",sans-serif';sc.textAlign='center';sc.textBaseline='middle';sc.fillStyle='#ffe176';sc.fillText(PELLET_ICONS[theme],size/2,size/2+size*.06);pelletSprites.set(id,sprite);
 }
 c.drawImage(pelletSprites.get(id),x-size/2,y-size/2,size,size);
}
function updatePelletSample(){
 const ids=['pelletIcon','powerIcon','projectileIcon'],labels=['Palline','Power','Proiettile'];
 const values=ids.map(id=>$(id).value);$('pelletSample').textContent=values.map((v,i)=>labels[i]+': '+(v==='classic'?['â—','â—‰','â€¢'][i]:PELLET_ICONS[v])).join('  |  ');
 $('pelletSample').setAttribute('aria-label',ids.map((id,i)=>labels[i]+': '+$(id).selectedOptions[0].textContent).join(', '));
}
let speechTime=0;
const CHARACTER_NAMES={pac:'PAC PAC',giovanni:'Giovanni',bruno:'Bruno'};
const characterImages={pac:null,giovanni:null,bruno:null};
const builtinCharacters={giovanni:'data:image/png;base64,',bruno:'data:image/png;base64,'};
function loadCharacter(id,data){
 if(!data){characterImages[id]=null;return}
 const img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{characterImages[id]=img;if(state==='settings')renderCharacterPreview();if(state==='menu')renderSplashCharacters()};img.onerror=()=>{characterImages[id]=null;toast('Immagine del personaggio non valida')};img.src=data;
}
function paintCharacter(c,x,y,size,id,dir=1){
 c.save();const img=characterImages[id];
 if(img){c.translate(x,y);if(dir===3)c.scale(-1,1);else if(dir===0)c.rotate(-Math.PI/2);else if(dir===2)c.rotate(Math.PI/2);c.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;const ratio=img.width/img.height,w=ratio>=1?size:size*ratio,h=ratio>=1?size/ratio:size;c.drawImage(img,-w/2,-h/2,w,h)}
 else if(id==='pac'){c.fillStyle='#ffe176';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y);c.arc(x,y,size*.43,.22*Math.PI,1.78*Math.PI);c.closePath();c.fill()}
 else{c.fillStyle='#58efff';c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,size*.3,0,Math.PI*2);c.strokeStyle='#58efff';c.stroke()}c.restore();
}
function paintSpeech(){
 const p=game.player,px=p.x*T+T/2,py=p.y*T+T/2,w=88,h=30;
 const x=Math.max(4,Math.min(N*T-w-4,px-w/2));const below=py<54;const y=below?py+23:py-h-23;
 ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.strokeStyle='#172442';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,9);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
 const tip=Math.max(x+12,Math.min(x+w-12,px));ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(tip-5,below?y:y+h);ctx.lineTo(px,below?py+15:py-15);ctx.lineTo(tip+5,below?y:y+h);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
 ctx.fillStyle='#101827';ctx.font='900 16px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillText('pac pac!',x+w/2,y+h/2);ctx.restore();
}
let characterPreviewDir=1;
function renderCharacterPreview(){
 const cv=$('characterPreview');if(!cv)return;const id=$('character').value,c=cv.getContext('2d');c.clearRect(0,0,128,128);paintCharacter(c,64,64,112,id,characterPreviewDir);
 cv.setAttribute('aria-label','Anteprima '+CHARACTER_NAMES[id]);$('characterNote').textContent=id==='giovanni'&&!characterImages.giovanni?'Immagine in caricamento: Giovanni.':CHARACTER_NAMES[id];
}
function syncCharacterUpload(){const fixed=$('character').value!=='pac';$('characterUpload').disabled=fixed;$('resetCharacter').disabled=fixed;}
function setupCharacterSettings(){
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-preview-dir]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{characterPreviewDir=Number(b.dataset.previewDir);renderCharacterPreview()});$('character').value=settings.character;$('speechBubble').checked=settings.speechBubble;
 $('character').onchange=()=>{renderCharacterPreview();updateLayoutPreview();syncCharacterUpload()};renderCharacterPreview();syncCharacterUpload();
 $('characterUpload').onchange=e=>{
  const f=e.target.files[0],id=$('character').value;if(!f)return;
  if(!['image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp'].includes(f.type)||f.size>5*1024*1024){toast('Usa PNG, JPG o WebP entro 5 MB');return}
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(f),img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{
   const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=cv.height=256;const c=cv.getContext('2d'),side=Math.min(img.width,img.height);c.drawImage(img,(img.width-side)/2,(img.height-side)/2,side,side,0,0,256,256);URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
   const data=cv.toDataURL('image/webp',.9);loadCharacter(id,data);try{localStorage.setItem('pacPacCharacter:'+id,data);toast('Immagine salvata sul dispositivo')}catch{toast('Immagine caricata solo per questa sessione')}
  };img.onerror=()=>{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);toast('Immagine non valida')};img.src=url;
 };
 $('resetCharacter').onclick=()=>{const id=$('character').value;try{localStorage.removeItem('pacPacCharacter:'+id)}catch{}loadCharacter(id,builtinCharacters[id]);renderCharacterPreview()};
}
for(const id of ['pac','giovanni','bruno']){let data=builtinCharacters[id];try{data=id==='pac'?(localStorage.getItem('pacPacCharacter:'+id)||data):builtinCharacters[id]}catch{}if(data)loadCharacter(id,data)}

let musicGain=null,musicNext=0,musicStep=0,musicRunning=false,musicNodes=new Set(),musicFile=null,musicFileURL=null,musicFileName='',musicPlayPending=false,musicFileFailed=false;
function unlockMusic(){
 try{audio??=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();if(audio.state==='suspended')audio.resume().catch(()=>{});if(!musicGain){musicGain=audio.createGain();musicGain.gain.value=0;musicGain.connect(audio.destination)}}catch{}
}
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',unlockMusic,{passive:true});document.addEventListener('keydown',unlockMusic);
function stopMusic(){if(projectMusic)projectMusic.pause();
 musicRunning=false;musicNext=0;
 if(musicGain&&audio){musicGain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(audio.currentTime);musicGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0,audio.currentTime)}
 for(const n of musicNodes){try{n.stop()}catch{}}musicNodes.clear();if(musicFile)musicFile.pause();
}
function musicNote(midi,at,length,type,level){
 const o=audio.createOscillator(),g=audio.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.value=440*2**((midi-69)/12);g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,at);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(level,at+.008);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,at+length);o.connect(g);g.connect(musicGain);musicNodes.add(o);o.onended=()=>{musicNodes.delete(o);o.disconnect();g.disconnect()};o.start(at);o.stop(at+length+.02);
}
function syncMusic(){
 const allowed=settings.music&&settings.musicVolume>0&&['playing','ready'].includes(state)&&!document.hidden;
 if(!allowed){if(musicRunning||musicFile&&!musicFile.paused||projectMusic&&!projectMusic.paused)stopMusic();return}
 if(settings.musicSource==='project'){syncProjectMusic();return}
 if(projectMusic&&!projectMusic.paused)projectMusic.pause();
 if(settings.musicSource==='file'&&musicFile){
  if(musicGain&&musicRunning){stopMusic()}
  musicFile.volume=settings.musicVolume/100;
  if(musicFile.paused&&!musicPlayPending&&!musicFileFailed){musicPlayPending=true;musicFile.play().catch(()=>{musicFileFailed=true;toast('Audio non riproducibile: prova un altro file o la musica originale.')}).finally(()=>{musicPlayPending=false;if(!settings.music||!['playing','ready'].includes(state)||document.hidden)musicFile.pause()})}return;
 }
 if(!audio||audio.state!=='running'||!musicGain)return;
 if(!musicRunning){musicRunning=true;musicNext=audio.currentTime+.03;musicStep=0}
 musicGain.gain.setTargetAtTime(settings.musicVolume/100*.38,audio.currentTime,.02);
 // Original 8-bar chiptune: independent melody, bass and arpeggio voices.
 const melody=[76,79,83,79,74,78,81,78,72,76,79,76,74,78,81,86,83,79,76,79,81,78,74,78,79,76,72,76,78,74,71,74];
 const roots=[52,50,48,55],chords=[[64,67,71],[62,66,69],[60,64,67],[62,67,71]];
 if(musicNext<audio.currentTime)musicNext=audio.currentTime+.02;
 while(musicNext<audio.currentTime+.12){const step=musicStep%32,bar=Math.floor(step/8),at=musicNext;
  musicNote(melody[step],at,.16,'triangle',.11);
  musicNote(chords[bar][step%3],at,.10,'square',.025);
  if(step%2===0)musicNote(roots[bar],at,.29,'triangle',.14);
  musicStep++;musicNext+=.205;
 }
}
function setupMusicSettings(){
 $('music').checked=settings.music;$('musicVolume').value=settings.musicVolume;$('musicVolumeLabel').textContent=settings.musicVolume+'%';$('musicSource').value=settings.musicSource;
 $('musicVolume').oninput=()=>{$('musicVolumeLabel').textContent=$('musicVolume').value+'%'};

  stopMusic();if(musicFileURL)URL.revokeObjectURL(musicFileURL);musicFileURL=URL.createObjectURL(f);musicFile=new Audio(musicFileURL);musicFile.loop=true;musicFileName=f.name;musicFileFailed=false;musicFile.onerror=()=>{musicFileFailed=true;toast('Formato audio non supportato: seleziona un altro file.')};$('musicSource').value='file';$('musicFileStatus').textContent='File caricato: '+f.name;
 };

}

const PELLET_AUDIO_PATH='./audio/hee-hee.mp3',GUN_AUDIO_PATH='./audio/gun.wav';
const activeEffects=new Set(),failedEffectPaths=new Set();
function playOneShot(path){
 if(!settings.sound||document.hidden||failedEffectPaths.has(path))return;
 try{
  const clip=new Audio(path);clip.loop=false;clip.volume=1;activeEffects.add(clip);
  const cleanup=()=>{activeEffects.delete(clip);clip.removeAttribute?.('src');clip.load?.()};
  clip.addEventListener('ended',cleanup,{once:true});
  clip.addEventListener('error',()=>{failedEffectPaths.add(path);cleanup()},{once:true});
  // One play call per gameplay event. No timer, loop, replay or frame-driven retry.
  const p=clip.play();if(p?.catch)p.catch(e=>{if(e.name==='NotSupportedError')failedEffectPaths.add(path);cleanup()});
 }catch{}
}
function playPelletAudio(){playOneShot(PELLET_AUDIO_PATH)}
function playGunAudio(){playOneShot(GUN_AUDIO_PATH)}
function stopPelletAudio(){for(const clip of activeEffects){try{clip.pause();clip.removeAttribute?.('src');clip.load?.()}catch{}}activeEffects.clear()}

const FIXED_STEP=1/120,MAX_FRAME_DELTA=.1,MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME=8;let droppedSimulationFrames=0,lastRenderAt=0;
function loop(now){
 syncMusic();if(!frameTime)frameTime=now;
 const delta=Math.min(Math.max(0,(now-frameTime)/1000),MAX_FRAME_DELTA);frameTime=now;
 if(!document.hidden){accumulator+=delta;let steps=0;while(accumulator>=FIXED_STEP&&steps<MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME){update(FIXED_STEP);accumulator-=FIXED_STEP;steps++}if(accumulator>=FIXED_STEP){accumulator%=FIXED_STEP;droppedSimulationFrames++}const interval=1000/({performance:30,balanced:45,quality:60}[settings.graphics]||45);if(now-lastRenderAt>=interval){lastRenderAt=now-(now-lastRenderAt)%interval;draw();hud();performanceStats.renderedFrames++}else performanceStats.skippedFrames++}else accumulator=0;
 if(toastUntil&&now>toastUntil){$('toast').classList.add('hidden');toastUntil=0}requestAnimationFrame(loop)
}

progress.max=Math.min(progress.max,100000);if(!Array.isArray(progress.completed))progress.completed=[];progress.completed=[...new Set(progress.completed.filter(n=>Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=1&&n<=100000))].slice(-10000);
function unlockLevel(level){if(!Number.isInteger(level)||level<1||level>100000)return;if(!progress.completed.includes(level))progress.completed.push(level);progress.max=Math.max(progress.max,level+1);saveStore('pacPacProgressV2',progress)}

 showModal(`<div class="eyebrow">IL TUO PERCORSO</div><h2 id="dialogTitle">Livelli sbloccati</h2><p>Disponibili: ${progress.max}. Completa un livello per sbloccare il successivo. Progressi salvati in questo browser, non sincronizzati tra dispositivi.</p><div class="level-grid">${Array.from({length:Math.max(0,last-first+1)},(_,i)=>{const n=first+i,locked=n>progress.max;return `<button data-level="${n}" ${locked?'disabled':''} aria-label="Livello ${n}, ${locked?'bloccato':progress.completed.includes(n)?'completato':'sbloccato'}"><canvas width="92" height="92" id="level-${n}" aria-hidden="true"></canvas><strong>${n}</strong><small>${locked?'ðŸ”’ Bloccato':progress.completed.includes(n)?'âœ“ Completato':'â–¶ Gioca'}</small></button>`}).join('')}</div><div class="actions"><button id="levelsPrev" ${page===0?'disabled':''}>â† Precedenti</button><button id="levelsNext" ${last>=progress.max+5?'disabled':''}>Successivi â†’</button><button id="levelsBack">Menu</button></div>`);
 state='levels';for(let n=first;n<=last;n++){const cv=$('level-'+n),c=cv.getContext('2d'),map=generateLevel(n),t=4;c.fillStyle='#050915';c.fillRect(0,0,92,92);for(let y=0;y<N;y++)for(let x=0;x<N;x++)if(map[y][x]===1){c.fillStyle=n>progress.max?'#29354a':'#286d95';c.fillRect(x*t,y*t,3,3)}}
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-level]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{startGame();game.level=Number(b.dataset.level);loadLevel()});$('levelsPrev').onclick=()=>openLevels(page-1);$('levelsNext').onclick=()=>openLevels(page+1);$('levelsBack').onclick=mainMenu;
}

 $('mpOffer').onclick=()=>netAction(async()=>{await makePeer(true);net.dc=net.pc.createDataChannel('pac-pac-v2');bindChannel(net.dc);await net.pc.setLocalDescription(await net.pc.createOffer());await gatherICE(net.pc);$('mpLocal').value=encodeSignal(net.pc.localDescription);mpStatus('Invia lâ€™invito a Bruno. async function netAction(fn){if(net?.busy)return;try{if(net)net.busy=true;await fn()}catch(e){mpStatus('Errore: '+e.message)}finally{if(net)net.busy=false}}
async function makePeer(host){
 if(!window.RTCPeerConnection)throw Error('WebRTC non disponibile in questo browser');
 const mode=$('mpMode').value,level=Number($('mpLevel').value),ice=$('mpIce')?JSON.parse($('mpIce').value||'[]'):TURN_CONFIG;
 if(!Array.isArray(ice)||ice.length>8)throw Error('Server ICE: usa un array JSON, massimo 8 elementi');
 if(!Number.isInteger(level)||level<1||level>progress.max)throw Error('Seleziona un livello sbloccato');
 netClose();net={host,mode,level,pc:new RTCPeerConnection({iceServers:ice}),dc:null,active:false,busy:true,sendTime:0,lastSeen:performance.now(),lastInput:0,fireAt:0,remoteFire:false,paused:false,result:null,seq:0,remoteSeq:0};
 const current=net;net.pc.ondatachannel=e=>{if(net!==current)return;net.dc=e.channel;bindChannel(e.channel)};
 net.pc.onconnectionstatechange=()=>{if(net!==current)return;const st=net.pc.connectionState;if(st==='failed'||st==='closed'||st==='disconnected')networkLost('Connessione interrotta. Esci e genera un nuovo invito.');else mpStatus('Rete: '+st)};
}
function gatherICE(pc){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{if(pc.iceGatheringState==='complete')return resolve();const timeout=setTimeout(()=>{cleanup();reject(Error('Raccolta ICE incompleta: verifica la rete e genera un nuovo codice'))},15000);const check=()=>{if(pc.iceGatheringState==='complete'){cleanup();resolve()}};function cleanup(){clearTimeout(timeout);pc.removeEventListener('icegatheringstatechange',check)}pc.addEventListener('icegatheringstatechange',check)})}
function encodeSignal(desc){return btoa(JSON.stringify({version:2,type:desc.type,sdp:desc.sdp}))}
function decodeSignal(value,type){if(value.length>100000)throw Error('Codice troppo lungo');const d=JSON.parse(atob(value.trim()));if(d.version!==2||d.type!==type||typeof d.sdp!=='string')throw Error('Codice non valido o versione diversa');return{type:d.type,sdp:d.sdp}}
function bindChannel(dc){
 const current=net;dc.onopen=()=>{if(net!==current)return;net.lastSeen=performance.now();mpStatus(net.host?'Bruno connesso. Puoi avviare la partita.':'Connesso come Bruno. Giovanni deve avviare la partita.');if($('mpStart'))$('mpStart').disabled=!net.host;netSend({type:'hello',version:2})};
 dc.onclose=()=>{if(net===current)networkLost('Lâ€™altro dispositivo si Ã¨ disconnesso.')};dc.onerror=()=>{if(net===current)networkLost('Errore del canale dati.')};
 dc.onmessage=e=>{if(net!==current||typeof e.data!=='string'||e.data.length>100000)return;try{receiveNetwork(JSON.parse(e.data))}catch{mpStatus('Messaggio non valido ignorato')}};
}
function networkLost(text){if(!net)return;net.active=false;net.paused=true;state='networkLost';stopTouchFire();showModal(`<h2 id="dialogTitle">Connessione persa</h2><p id="lostText"></p><button id="lostExit">Torna al menu</button>`);$('lostText').textContent=text;$('lostExit').onclick=mainMenu}
function receiveNetwork(m){
 if(!net||!m||typeof m.type!=='string')return;net.lastSeen=performance.now();
 if(m.type==='hello'){if(m.version!==2)networkLost('Versione multiplayer non compatibile');return}
 if(net.host){
  if(m.type==='input'&&net.active&&Number.isInteger(m.seq)&&m.seq>net.remoteSeq){net.remoteSeq=m.seq;if(Number.isInteger(m.dir)&&m.dir>=0&&m.dir<4)networkDirection(1,m.dir);if(m.fire===true)networkShoot(1)}
  if(m.type==='pause'&&net.active){net.paused=true;net.remoteFire=false;stopTouchFire();state='paused';networkPausePanel();sendSnapshot()}
  return;
 }
 if(m.type==='snapshot'&&validSnapshot(m)){
  const wasActive=net.active,oldPaused=net.paused,oldResult=net.result;
  net.active=true;net.mode=m.mode;net.paused=m.paused;net.result=m.result;game=m.game;game.player=game.players[0];activeDifficulty=m.difficulty;activeGhosts=m.ghosts;state=m.state;
  if(m.unlocked&&!progress.completed.includes(game.level))unlockLevel(game.level);
  if(!wasActive){hideModal();fit()}
  if(m.result&&!oldResult)networkResultPanel();else if(m.paused&&!oldPaused)networkPausePanel();else if((oldPaused||oldResult)&&!m.paused&&!m.result)hideModal();
 }
 if(m.type==='effect'){if(m.kind==='power')playPelletAudio();if(m.kind==='gun')playGunAudio()}
}
function validSnapshot(m){const g=m.game;return ['coop','versus'].includes(m.mode)&&['ready','playing','paused','clear'].includes(m.state)&&g&&Array.isArray(g.map)&&g.map.length===N&&g.map.every(r=>Array.isArray(r)&&r.length===N&&r.every(v=>[0,1,2,3,6].includes(v)))&&Array.isArray(g.players)&&g.players.length===2&&g.players.every(p=>Number.isFinite(p.x)&&Number.isFinite(p.y)&&p.x>=0&&p.x<N&&p.y>=0&&p.y<N)&&Array.isArray(g.ghosts)&&g.ghosts.length<=4&&Array.isArray(g.bullets)&&g.bullets.length<100&&['easy','normal','hard'].includes(m.difficulty)&&m.ghosts&&['basic','normal','expert'].includes(m.ghosts.skill)}
function sendSnapshot(){if(!net?.host||!net.active||!game)return;game.player=game.players[0];netSend({type:'snapshot',game,mode:net.mode,paused:net.paused,result:net.result,state,difficulty:activeDifficulty,ghosts:activeGhosts,unlocked:!!game.cleared})}
function startNetworkRound(level){
 if(!net?.host)return;net.level=level;net.result=null;net.paused=false;activeDifficulty=settings.difficulty;activeGhosts={skill:settings.ghostSkill,style:settings.ghostStyle,speed:settings.ghostSpeed};
 game={level,score:0,lives:6,ammo:6,extraAt:Infinity};loadLevel();
 game.players=[{...entity(1,21),points:0,ammo:6,cooldown:0,invuln:3,stun:0,speech:0},{...entity(21,21),points:0,ammo:6,cooldown:0,invuln:3,stun:0,speech:0}];game.player=game.players[0];game.map[21][1]=2;game.map[21][21]=2;game.remaining=game.map.flat().filter(v=>v===0||v===3).length;game.cleared=false;net.active=true;net.lastSeen=performance.now();netHeartbeatAt=0;netWarned=false;net.sendTime=0;unlockMusic();sendSnapshot();
}
function networkDirection(id,d){if(!game?.players||state!=='playing'||net.paused)return;const p=game.players[id];p.next=d;if(p.moving&&d===(p.dir+2)%4){[p.fromX,p.toX]=[p.toX,p.fromX];[p.fromY,p.toY]=[p.toY,p.fromY];p.progress=1-p.progress;p.dir=d}}
function networkInput(d,fire=false){if(!net?.active)return;if(net.host){if(d!==null)networkDirection(0,d);if(fire)networkShoot(0)}else netSend({type:'input',seq:++net.seq,dir:d,fire})}
function networkShoot(id){
 if(!net?.host||state!=='playing'||net.paused)return;const p=game.players[id];if(p.cooldown>0||p.ammo<=0||p.stun>0)return;
 const [dx,dy]=DIRS[p.dir];p.ammo--;p.cooldown=.25;p.speech=.65;game.bullets.push({x:p.x+dx*.4,y:p.y+dy*.4,dx,dy,life:2,owner:id});playGunAudio();netSend({type:'effect',kind:'gun'});
}
function networkConsume(p,id){
 const v=game.map[p.y][p.x];if(v===0||v===3){game.map[p.y][p.x]=2;game.remaining--;p.points+=v===3?50:10;if(v===3){game.power=CONFIG[activeDifficulty].power;game.ghosts.forEach(g=>g.reverse=true);playPelletAudio();netSend({type:'effect',kind:'power'})}}
 else if(v===6){game.map[p.y][p.x]=2;p.ammo=Math.min(20,p.ammo+3);p.points+=30}
 if(game.remaining===0)finishNetwork(true);
}
function networkHit(id,shot=false){const p=game.players[id];if(p.invuln>0)return;if(net.mode==='coop')game.lives--;else p.points=Math.max(0,p.points-(shot?50:100));const start=id===0?1:21;Object.assign(p,entity(start,21));p.invuln=3;p.stun=shot?.7:0;if(game.lives<=0)finishNetwork(false)}
function updateNetwork(dt){
 if(!net?.active)return;
 net.sendTime+=dt;
 if(!net.host){if(fireHeld&&performance.now()-net.fireAt>250){net.fireAt=performance.now();networkInput(null,true)}return}
 if(net.sendTime>=1/10){net.sendTime=0;sendSnapshot()}
 if(net.result||net.paused)return;

const NET_HEARTBEAT_MS=2000,NET_WARN_MS=4500,NET_PAUSE_MS=8000,NET_DROP_MS=15000;

# Ralph racconta: Il compagno rapito

La modalitÃ  consente di scegliere Giovanni o Bruno. Il personaggio non selezionato viene rapito; gli otto atti seguono la ricerca dalla Transilvania a Roma.

## Labirinti
Ogni atto usa una topologia distinta: spirale, isole e fossati, rotore, trittico, cuore fortificato, rete di strade, anelli e croce fluviale. Acqua e castello sono invalicabili. Le palline sono generate solo sui corridoi, mai nelle celle acqua o castello. Le traiettorie dei muri mobili sono riservate come pavimento per non cancellare raccoglibili.

## Power-up personaggio
- Giovanni: boccale Birra. Power, velocitÃ  120%, munizioni infinite e raffica per 10 secondi.
- Bruno: Stella. Gli stessi effetti per 10 secondi.

## Elementi ambientali
Fiaccole animate, fiumi, fossati, acqua, trappole a pavimento, muri mobili e portali con cooldown.

## Trama
Le scene sono ridotte a un intervento di Ralph, una battuta del protagonista e, quando utile, una risposta dell'antagonista. La storia rivela progressivamente che il rapimento serve a Dracula per convertire il Legame in una rete di portali verso Roma.

================================================================================
# PAC PAC 4.5.0 - Campaign & Level Platform

Release completa basata sulla 3.3.2, con contratto storico 2.5.1, campagna JSON, Arcade infinito, Level Studio e validazione automatica.

## Splash screen adattiva
- Desktop e PC usano `assets/splash/pac-pac-journey-desktop.webp`.
- Smartphone in verticale usano `assets/splash/pac-pac-journey-mobile.webp`.
- Le animazioni rispettano `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Tutti i riferimenti sono relativi e compatibili con GitHub Pages.

## Manuale
- Dal menu principale selezionare **Manuale di gioco**.
- La guida integrata include ricerca e indice.
- `manual.html` offre una pagina autonoma stampabile e collegabile direttamente da GitHub Pages.

## Avvio
Il caricamento JSON richiede un server locale. Dalla cartella del repository:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8080
```

Aprire `http://localhost:8080`. Per WebRTC e API native usare localhost o HTTPS.

## Story Game: Ralph racconta - Il compagno rapito
Il giocatore sceglie Giovanni o Bruno; l'altro viene rapito. Otto labirinti unici seguono la ricerca dalla Transilvania a Roma. La modalitÃ  introduce acqua invalicabile, fiumi, fiaccole, trappole, muri mobili, maze a spirale, isole, rotori, trittici, anelli e croci fluviali.

Giovanni raccoglie Power Birra; Bruno raccoglie Power Stella. Entrambe attivano Power, velocitÃ  al 120%, munizioni infinite e raffica per 10 secondi. I racconti sono ridotti a scene brevi e non ripetitive: Ralph porta avanti il mistero del rapimento e rivela il piano di Dracula solo nel quinto atto.

Dettagli tecnici e narrativi sono disponibili in `README-STORY-450.md`.

## Story Game: Castelli, Fantasmi e Strade Romane
Ralph, cane narratore in pixel art, presenta la storia tramite fumetti. I primi quattro capitoli si svolgono nei castelli della Transilvania, controllati dalle antagoniste originali Vespera, Glacia e Morvella. Il quinto capitolo Ã¨ lo scontro con Dracula. Trastevere, quartiere di Roma, apre l'arco urbano; il Colosseo introduce sei fantasmi e portali instabili; il Vaticano ospita il boss immaginario Custode della Cupola.

Nei capitoli boss, una volta terminate le palline si apre una seconda fase: le sfere-sigillo riattivano il Power e ogni fantasma sconfitto riduce la salute del boss. Ralph commenta introduzioni, missioni e conclusioni con fumetti.

## Story Game: Le Strade del Legame
Giovanni, muratore originario della Romania, e Bruno, romano, giÃ  steward e amante dellâ€™arte e della vita mondana, sono protagonisti di un viaggio in otto capitoli. I primi cinque livelli attraversano SighiÈ™oara, BraÈ™ov, i Carpazi, il Castello di Bran e Sibiu. Gli ultimi capitoli sono ambientati a Trastevere, al Colosseo e al Vaticano. Giovanni Ã¨ il personaggio controllato; Bruno Ã¨ il compagno visibile che segue il percorso e alimenta la meccanica **Legame**.

Il Legame aumenta raccogliendo sfere, avanzando insieme e sconfiggendo fantasmi. Al 100% attiva un bonus condiviso: Power temporaneo e due munizioni. Capitoli, record di Legame e avanzamento sono salvati in `pacpac-story-450`.

## ModalitÃ 
- **Campagna / Normale:** 20 livelli progettati, progressione sequenziale, introduzione graduale delle meccaniche e stelle.
- **Arcade infinito:** generazione procedurale deterministica, tre vite, combo, near miss, ghost chain, record e medaglie.
- **Sfida giornaliera:** seed giornaliero condiviso e metriche salvate solo in locale.
- **Caccia inversa:** il giocatore caccia e i fantasmi fuggono.
- **Multiplayer:** cooperativo o versus, con pairing manuale o signaling Worker.

## File dei livelli
- `levels/manifest.json`: ordine, nomi, sblocchi e percorso dei livelli.
- `levels/campaign/level-001.json` ... `level-020.json`: campagna ufficiale.
- `levels/community/`: livelli esportati dall'editor.
- `levels/arcade/`: eventuali preset Arcade; l'Arcade infinito resta procedurale.

## Aggiungere un livello facilmente
1. Aprire **Level Studio** dal gioco.
2. Creare, disegnare e validare il livello.
3. Usare **Prova**.
4. Premere **Scarica JSON**.
5. Copiare il file in `levels/community/` o `levels/campaign/`.
6. Aggiungere nel `levels/manifest.json` una voce:

```json
{
  "id": "level-021",
  "order": 21,
  "name": "Nuovo livello",
  "file": "campaign/level-021.json",
  "unlockAfter": "level-020",
  "mechanics": ["pellets", "fire-door", "portals"]
}
```

7. Eseguire i test.

## Schema livello
Ogni livello usa `schemaVersion: 2` e contiene `map`, `entities`, `settings` e `objectives`. Le entitÃ  supportate sono porte FIRE, porte automatiche, portali A/B, spawn giocatore e spawn fantasmi; la mappa supporta palline, Power Sphere, munizioni, muri e pavimento.

## Miglioramenti di gameplay 4.0
- FIRE apre prioritariamente la porta frontale e non spreca il colpo.
- Messaggio per munizioni insufficienti.
- Porte automatiche con preavviso e protezione di occupazione.
- Portali con accoppiamento, feedback e cooldown.
- Contatore raccoglibili e segnalazione ultime cinque palline.
- Combo con avanzamento verso il moltiplicatore successivo.
- Near miss valido solo dopo ingresso, uscita e spostamento minimo.
- Progressione a piÃ¹ dimensioni: munizioni, potere, porte, portali, numero fantasmi e difficoltÃ .
- Metriche esclusivamente locali per tempo, punteggio, vite, munizioni e combo.

## Test

```bash
for f in tests/*.test.js; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
```

/* PAC PAC 4.7.3 animated launcher background */
.game-launcher-472{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;border-radius:22px;padding:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#081423dd,#111b36dd 48%,#321b3ddd);box-shadow:0 22px 70px #0009,0 0 0 1px #6fefff20 inset;animation:launcher-arrive-473 .48s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1) both}.game-launcher-472::before,.game-launcher-472::after{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-2;width:360px;height:360px;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(10px);opacity:.28;pointer-events:none}.game-launcher-472::before{left:-170px;top:-210px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#58efff 0,transparent 67%);animation:orb-cyan-473 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.game-launcher-472::after{right:-190px;bottom:-230px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#ff68bc 0,transparent 68%);animation:orb-pink-473 11s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.menu-stars-473{position:absolute;z-index:-1;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}.menu-stars-473 i{position:absolute;left:var(--x);top:var(--y);width:var(--s);height:var(--s);border-radius:50%;background:#d9faff;box-shadow:0 0 8px #58efff;animation:star-float-473 var(--d) ease-in-out infinite alternate}.launcher-mode-472{animation:card-rise-473 .45s both}.launcher-mode-472:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.045s}.launcher-mode-472:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.09s}.launcher-mode-472:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.135s}.launcher-mode-472:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.18s}.launcher-mode-472.story::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-60% -45%;background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 42%,#ffe17618 49%,#fff8c833 50%,#ffe17618 51%,transparent 58%);transform:translateX(-65%);animation:story-shine-473 6s ease-in-out infinite}.launcher-avatar-472{transition:transform .18s,border-color .18s,box-shadow .18s!important}.launcher-avatar-472:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.025)}.launcher-avatar-472[aria-pressed="true"]{animation:selected-glow-473 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}.pulse-character-473 .launcher-avatar-472[aria-pressed="true"]{animation:character-pick-473 .36s ease-out,selected-glow-473 2.4s .36s ease-in-out infinite}.launcher-go-472{animation:arrow-nudge-473 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}.launcher-tools-472{animation:card-rise-473 .48s .18s both}@keyframes launcher-arrive-473{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.985)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}@keyframes card-rise-473{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}@keyframes orb-cyan-473{to{transform:translate(95px,95px) scale(1.16)}}@keyframes orb-pink-473{to{transform:translate(-90px,-100px) scale(1.2)}}@keyframes star-float-473{from{opacity:.15;transform:translateY(0) scale(.7)}to{opacity:.9;transform:translateY(-16px) scale(1.25)}}@keyframes story-shine-473{0%,65%{transform:translateX(-65%)}90%,100%{transform:translateX(65%)}}@keyframes selected-glow-473{50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #ffe17666 inset,0 0 22px #ffe17640}}@keyframes character-pick-473{45%{transform:scale(1.08) rotate(-1deg)}}@keyframes arrow-nudge-473{50%{transform:translateX(4px)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.game-launcher-472,.game-launcher-472::before,.game-launcher-472::after,.menu-stars-473 i,.launcher-mode-472,.launcher-mode-472.story::before,.launcher-avatar-472,.launcher-go-472,.launcher-tools-472{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
/* PAC PAC 4.7.5 primary game sign */
.launcher-head-472{align-items:center!important}.launcher-title-row-472{flex:1;text-align:center!important}.launcher-brand-475{margin:0;font:1000 clamp(42px,8vw,78px)/.9 system-ui;letter-spacing:-.055em;color:#ffe176;text-shadow:0 3px 0 #b36b25,0 7px 0 #633754,0 12px 28px #000b,0 0 26px #58efff55;transform:skew(-2deg);white-space:nowrap}.launcher-eyebrow-472{align-self:flex-start;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid #34566f;border-radius:999px;background:#07111dcc}.launcher-title-row-472 p{text-align:center!important}@media(max-width:520px){.launcher-brand-475{font-size:clamp(34px,11vw,52px)}.launcher-head-472{gap:5px}.launcher-eyebrow-472{font-size:7px;padding:4px 6px}}
/* 4.7.8 futuristic audio visualizer: decorative background only. */
.audio-visualizer-478{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.9;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 80%,#10264a44,transparent 55%)}
#app{position:relative;z-index:1}
#modal{z-index:5}.game-launcher-472,.splash-panel{position:relative;isolation:isolate;background-color:#0b1323e8!important;backdrop-filter:blur(9px)}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.audio-visualizer-478{opacity:.55}}



================================================================================
FILE: .\audio\README.md
================================================================================
Copy the original optional assets here: `smoot-criminal.mp3`, `hee-hee.mp3`, `gun.wav`. Missing audio never blocks gameplay.

- `gameover.mp3`: riprodotto alla morte del personaggio; fallback sintetico se assente.

export default {async fetch(request,env){const cors={'access-control-allow-origin':env.APP_ORIGIN||'*','access-control-allow-headers':'content-type','access-control-allow-methods':'GET,POST,PUT,OPTIONS','content-type':'application/json'};if(request.method==='OPTIONS')return new Response(null,{headers:cors});try{const url=new URL(request.url),parts=url.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);if(parts[0]!=='rooms')return json({error:'Not found'},404,cors);if(request.method==='POST'&&parts.length===1){const body=await safeBody(request);if(!validSignal(body.offer,'offer'))return json({error:'Invalid offer'},400,cors);let code;for(let i=0;i<8;i++){code=randomCode();if(!await env.ROOMS.get(code))break}await env.ROOMS.put(code,JSON.stringify({offer:body.offer,answer:null}),{expirationTtl:600});return json({code},201,cors)}if(parts.length>=2){const code=cleanCode(parts[1]);if(!code)return json({error:'Invalid room code'},400,cors);const raw=await env.ROOMS.get(code);if(!raw)return json({error:'Room not found or expired'},404,cors);const room=JSON.parse(raw);if(request.method==='GET'&&parts.length===2)return json(room,200,cors);if(request.method==='PUT'&&parts[2]==='answer'){const body=await safeBody(request);if(!validSignal(body.answer,'answer'))return json({error:'Invalid answer'},400,cors);if(room.answer)return json({error:'Room already joined'},409,cors);room.answer=body.answer;await env.ROOMS.put(code,JSON.stringify(room),{expirationTtl:600});return json({ok:true},200,cors)}}return json({error:'Method not allowed'},405,cors)}catch{return json({error:'Request failed'},400,cors)}}};
function json(data,status,headers){return new Response(JSON.stringify(data),{status,headers})}async function safeBody(r){const text=await r.text();if(text.length>120000)throw Error();return JSON.parse(text)}function cleanCode(v){v=String(v).toUpperCase();return/^[A-Z2-9]{6}$/.test(v)?v:null}function validSignal(v,type){if(typeof v!=='string'||v.length<20||v.length>100000)return false;try{const d=JSON.parse(atob(v));return d.version===2&&d.type===type&&typeof d.sdp==='string'&&d.sdp.length<90000}catch{return false}}function randomCode(){const chars='ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789',a=new Uint32Array(6);crypto.getRandomValues(a);return Array.from(a,n=>chars[n%chars.length]).join('')}
